questions.prompt: Which soil conservation method uses alternating strips of crops to slow runoff on a slope?
questions.correctAnswer: Strip cropping
questions.explanation: Strip cropping places different crops in strips so that runoff loses speed and carries away less soil.
questions.learningOutcome: Describe methods of soil conservation in the agricultural environment.

questions.prompt: Stone lines can reduce soil erosion by slowing runoff and trapping soil particles.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Stone lines break the speed of flowing water and help soil settle instead of being washed away.
questions.learningOutcome: Identify soil conservation measures used in farming environments.

questions.prompt: A school garden has runoff channels forming after heavy rain. Which measure would best guide water safely across the garden?
questions.correctAnswer: Grassed waterway
questions.explanation: A grassed waterway protects the channel with grass so runoff moves with less erosion.
questions.learningOutcome: Select suitable soil conservation methods for an agricultural environment.

questions.prompt: Why are trash lines useful on a cultivated slope?
options: They slow runoff and add organic matter as plant waste decays
They make soil dry faster during drought
They attract pests to healthy crops
They replace the need for any crop care
questions.correctAnswer: They slow runoff and add organic matter as plant waste decays
questions.explanation: Trash lines use crop residues or plant materials to slow water movement and improve soil as they decompose.
questions.learningOutcome: Explain how soil conservation methods protect soil resources.

questions.prompt: Name one soil conservation activity learners can carry out around a school garden.
questions.correctAnswer: Construct trash lines
questions.explanation: Learners can construct trash lines, stone lines, soil bunds, grassed waterways, or practise strip cropping where suitable.
questions.learningOutcome: Carry out soil conservation activities in the environment.

questions.prompt: Which situation shows responsible care for soil during a class conservation activity?
options: Learners work in assigned roles and observe safety precautions
Learners remove all grass from waterways
Learners dump plastics in the garden
questions.correctAnswer: Learners work in assigned roles and observe safety precautions
questions.explanation: Responsibility includes active participation, safety, and solving soil conservation problems carefully.
questions.learningOutcome: Demonstrate a caring attitude towards soil in the environment.

questions.prompt: A farm path is becoming a deep erosion channel. Which first action best helps learners choose the right conservation method?

Plant vegetables without checking the slope
Sweep soil into the channel daily
Store harvested water in an open bucket

questions.prompt: Explain how a class can use locally available materials to reduce soil erosion in a school garden.
questions.correctAnswer: A good response should describe using materials such as stones, grass, or crop residues to make stone lines, grassed waterways, trash lines, or soil bunds, and should include safe teamwork.
questions.explanation: The task checks whether learners can connect local materials with practical soil conservation methods and responsible participation.
questions.learningOutcome: Plan soil conservation activities using locally available resources.

questions.prompt: Which item is most suitable for storing harvested rainwater for domestic use at school?

questions.prompt: A school wants water for cleaning classrooms during dry days. Which plan is most suitable?

Keep rainwater in open tins under trees

questions.learningOutcome: Explain safe practices when storing harvested water.

questions.prompt: Design a simple school routine for harvesting and storing rainwater safely for cleaning activities.

questions.learningOutcome: Plan responsible water harvesting and storage activities in school.

questions.prompt: What is one main role of a kitchen garden at home?

questions.prompt: What is a poultry fold mainly used for?

questions.prompt: Give one reason for protecting poultry in a fold from harsh weather.

questions.prompt: Which sign on vegetable leaves may show pest attack?
